THE RESEARCH NOTEBOOK

Behind the side quests.

This is a fictional composite, not a reconstruction of a single protest. Characters, dialogue, map, rewards and all numerical effects are invented. Reporting about viral clips does not establish that a tactic works or represents an entire generation.

Research checked 15 October 2026. The July reporting concerns exam-related protests; the October clips concern protests against the election chief. Real detention and injuries have consequences that an arcade meter cannot represent.
